basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of alternative rock and metal, with a special place in my heart for Gojira. Originally from Dublin, I work as a courier, which means I'm always on the road, catching glimpses of the city's rhythm. I enjoy discussing niche topics, especially when it comes to music and unique cultural phenomena. Often found online during late nights, unwinding after a day's work. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies and interests, from music gigs to the occasional tech deep dive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught music enthusiast with a deep appreciation for metal bands, cultivated over years of attending concerts and engaging with online music communities. Additionally, has a decent understanding of logistics and the courier lifestyle, gained from firsthand work experience.
